host.description: Host to bind the local server to (e.g. '127.0.0.1', '0.0.0.0')

port.description: Port number for the local server (default from grip manpage: 6419)

api_url.description: Base URL of the GitHub API (e.g. GitHub Enterprise instance)

password.description: GitHub password or personal access token (optional)

context.description: Repository context in 'owner/repo' format for user-content rendering

user_content.description: Render as user-content (e.g. comments, issues) instead of full README

refresh.description: Automatically refresh content on file change

no_inline.description: When exporting, link to styles instead of inlining them
